titles.romaji: Himitsukessha Taka no Tsume Gaiden: Mukashi no Yoshida-kun
titles.native: むかしの吉田くん－秘密結社鷹の爪外伝－

description:
The television shorts follow the original anime's Yoshida-kun character as he travels through western Japan's Shimane Prefecture, his birthplace, in the past. Each episode of the Shimane sightseeing guide program introduce one famous place in the prefecture.

(Source: Anime News Network)
